greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
psalm_response: Niya kukha amanzi ngovuyo kwimithombo yosindiso.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka ngathi yincwadi evulekileyo, ezele ngamanani, iikhowudi, kunye nezicwangciso zekamva. Khumbula uBenjamin Vo, umfana owayehlala phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, edala imidlalo, efunda iinkqubo ezinzima zika-AWS, kwaye ecinga ngendlela yokwakha inkampani yakhe yeenqwelo-moya, le 'con chim airlines' awayeyithanda kakhulu. Xa uBen wayethetha ngaloo nqwelo-moya, ubuso bakhe babukhanya ngoncumo olungenakuthelekiswa nanto. Wayengumfana owayebona ngaphaya kwesikrini, ebona ububanzi behlabathi, ebona ukuba ubomi bunokubhabha kude, bunokufikelela kwiindawo ezintsha, kwaye bunokuba yinto enkulu kunokuba singayicinga apha emhlabeni.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usikhumbuza ngento enkulu kakhulu. Uthi: 'Kuye, owona mncinci kubo bonke abangcwele, wanikwa olu bubele, ukuba ndishumayele kwizizwe ubutyebi bukaKristu obungenakubalwa.' Ubutyebi obungenakubalwa. UBen wayeyazi le nyaniso ngendlela yakhe ethuleyo. Khumbula ukuba wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye. Xa wayeneminyaka elishumi nanhlanje, unina noyise bakhumbula umnqweno wakhe wokunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange encinci yakhe ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi. Kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela ukuba sibe 'njengezicaka ezilindele ukubuya kwenkosi yazo.' Uthi: 'Blessed is that servant whom his master on arrival finds doing so.' (Nokuba uza kumlindo wesibini okanye wesithathu, bazukile abo bakhonzi). Mamele le nyaniso: uYesu akalindi nje ukuba sikhonze, kodwa uYesu uzimisele ukusikhonza. UBen, ngoku, usebukhoneni obo, apho uYesu emkhonza ngoxolo olungunaphakade. UBen wayengumfana owayehlala elungiselele, hayi ngokoyika, kodwa ngothando. Wayengumfana owayephila ngathi uYesu uza kufika ngalo naliphi na ixesha, kwaye wayefuna ukuba xa efika, amfumane enoncumo, enothando, kwaye enentliziyo evulekileyo.

Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba ukhumbula uBen kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale roller coaster enayikhwela ngeziganeko ezimnandi, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwesi Sakramente soBungcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla onke angasithamsanqelisa, asigcine kuxolo lwakhe, kwaye asikhokele kwiindlela zakhe. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngokuthula ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wokudabuka, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliphilayo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Nivile ngokuphathwa kobabalo lukaThixo olwanikwa mna ngenxa yenu, okokuba imfihlelo yaziswa mna ngesityhilelo, njengoko ndabhalayo kancinane ngaphambili. Xa nifunda oku, nani ningaqonda ukuqonda kwam kwimfihlo kaKristu, eyayingenziwa yaziwe kubantu kwizizukulwana ezinye, njengoko ngoku ityhilelwe kubapostile bakhe abangcwele nakubaprofeti ngoMoya, okokuba iintlanga zingamahlakani azuzayo, zibe ngamalungu omzimba omnye, zibe ngamahlakani kwidinga kuKristu Yesu ngeVangeli. Ndayenziwa umphathiswa wayo le nto ngesipho sobabalo lukaThixo, olwanikwa mna ngokusebenza kwamandla akhe. Kum, owona mncinci kubo bonke abangcwele, wanikwa olu bubele, ukuba ndishumayele kwizizwe ubutyebi bukaKristu obungenakubalwa, nokukhanyisa kubo bonke ukuba yintoni na ucwangciso lwemfihlelo leyo, eyayifihlakele kwiminyaka yakudala kuThixo owadala zonke izinto, ukuze ubulumko bukaThixo obuninzi ngoku bube yinto eyaziswayo ngeBandla kubaphathi nakubagunyaziweyo basezulwini. Oku kwakungokwenjongo engunaphakade awayifezayo kuKristu Yesu iNkosi yethu, ekuye esinako kuye ukuthetha ngesibindi nokufikelela ngokuzithemba ngokukholwa kuye.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Niya kukha amanzi ngovuyo kwimithombo yosindiso. UThixo ngokwenene ungumsindisi wam; ndizithembile, andoyiki. Amandla am nesibindi sam yiNkosi, kwaye yiyo umsindisi wam. Ngovuyo niya kukha amanzi emthonjeni wosindiso. R. Niya kukha amanzi ngovuyo kwimithombo yosindiso. Bulelani eNkosini, nibhengeze igama layo; phakathi kweentlanga yazisani izenzo zayo, vakalisani indlela eliphakamileyo ngayo igama layo. R. Niya kukha amanzi ngovuyo kwimithombo yosindiso. Dumisani iNkosi ngenxa yempumelelo yayo ebalaseleyo; makwazeke oku emhlabeni wonke. Khwazani ngovuyo, mzi weZiyon, kuba mkhulu phakathi kwenu oyiNgcwele kaSirayeli! R. Niya kukha amanzi ngovuyo kwimithombo yosindiso.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: 'Qinisani intliziyo ngoku: ukuba umninindlu ebesazi ukuba liza kufika ngaliphi na ilixa isela, ebesayi kuhlala elindile, engayivumi indlu yakhe ukuba iqhekezwe. Nani ke hlalani nilungile, kuba ngelixa ningalicingeliyo, uNyana woMntu uya kufika.' UPetros wathi, 'Nkosi, lo mzekelo uthetha ngathi na, okanye wonke umntu?' INkosi yaphendula yathi, 'Ngubani na ke umphathi othembekileyo noqiqayo, oya kubekwa yinkosi yakhe phezu kwezicaka zayo, ukuba azinike isabelo sokutya ngexesha elililo? Unoyolo olo sicaka, esiya kuthi inkosi yakhe ifike imfumane esenza njalo. Inene, ndithi kuni, iya kumbeka phezu kwayo yonke impahla yayo. Kodwa ukuba eso sicaka sathi entliziyweni yaso, "Inkosi yam ilibazisa ukuza," saza saqalisa ukubetha izicaka namadodana, nokutya nokusela nokunxila, inkosi yeso sicaka iya kufika ngemini engalindelwanga nangelixa elingaziwayo, iya kusohlwaya kakhulu, imabele indawo kunye nabangathembekanga. Eso sicaka besisazi intando yenkosi yaso, kodwa singazilungiselelanga, singenzanga ngokwentando yayo, siya kubethwa kakhulu; kwaye eso sicaka besingayazi intando yenkosi yaso, kodwa sisenza izinto ezifaneleyo ukubethwa kakhulu, siya kubethwa kancinci. Wonke umntu onikwe lukhulu, uya kubuzwa lukhulu; nalowo ubekwe lukhulu, uya kucelwa lukhulu nangaphezulu.'

day: Wednesday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
